notes.title: A major update is now live!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your continued support! Over the past couple of days, we’ve rolled out a lot of optimization updates that you can experience once you update the game!

Here are the specific updates:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some items could not be picked up or were lost.
[*] Fixed bugs that caused certain processes to freeze.
[*] Fixed issues with some save errors.
[*] Optimized the gaming experience of some mini-games.
[*] Added hints for solving puzzles and a skip feature for certain puzzles.
[/list]

We really appreciate your ongoing support! We are still working hard on optimizing the game and adding localization features. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: First Update Live! And Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Massive thanks for the incredible support and enthusiasm for Reviver! We're thrilled to launch our first update, addressing several key areas based directly on your feedback.

[h1][b]Your voice matters! We value your thoughts immensely. Leave a review on Steam and help us shape Reviver into something truly special.[/b][/h1]

We've been diligently working through your reports, squashing bugs and polishing the experience. The update is ready to download; dive back in – your saves are safe and sound!

[b]Here’s a glimpse at what’s new:[/b]

[list]
[*] Revamped the 30-Year Sort minigame for improved flow and intuitiveness.
[*] Polished existing text for greater clarity and immersion.
[*] Resolved the Mac resolution switching issue.
[*] Restored missing artwork in specific levels.
[*] Addressed various miscellaneous gameplay enhancements.
[/list]

[h1][b]A sneak peek at what's on the horizon (in no particular order):[/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*] Trading Cards & Community Items are coming soon!
[*] Free Wallpaper DLC on its way.
[*] Ongoing bug fixes and performance optimization.
[*] Level and gameplay refinements in the pipeline.
[*] Russian localization.
[*] Korean localization.
[*] Steam Deck compatibility.
[*] And much more…
[/olist]

Thanks again for being part of this journey. We're passionately committed to refining Reviver and delivering the best possible experience. 

See you in-game!
